scope: The three requested reports, their principal constructions and elementary supporting proofs. Deep cited research theorems remain separate from locally expanded proofs; not a claim to reconstruct all proofs in the source bibliography.

reports.speaker: Dawid Kielak
reports.title: Virtual Fibring of Manifolds and Groups
reports.question: 哪些有限覆盖能把流形展开为映射环面，群同调如何检测这种可能性？
reports.reading_scope: arXiv v1 main text sections 1-4 and selected bibliography; publisher catalogue and Oxford repository metadata checked. Publisher full text unavailable in this run; no independent PDF diagram inspection.
reports.license: arXiv v1 CC BY 4.0; publisher version CC BY 4.0 according to Oxford repository metadata
normalization_and_corrections: Exclude the zero character in the BNS kernel criterion; state left/right coefficient modules explicitly.
Use conservative oriented irreducible form of Stallings rather than the survey's blanket simplified three-manifold statement.
Mapping-torus L2 vanishing does not require an aspherical fibre; group and space L2 homology are distinguished.
Distinguish field FP, integral FP, finite classifying space, PD group and geometric fibering.
The bilateral sequence module has no unrestricted convolution product; Novikov short exact sequence is a module sequence.
deferred: Bieri-Renz/Sikorav proofs, division-ring construction, RFRS coefficient-transfer theorem and Farrell high-dimensional obstruction theory are cited, not reconstructed.
Simultaneous all-field integral PD refinements, detailed hyperbolic examples and arithmetic construction proofs require further dedicated notes.
The integral PD and high-dimensional geometric fibering conjectures retain conjectural status.

reports.speaker: Alexander Kupers
reports.title: Manifolds and Disc-Presheaves
reports.question: 有限圆盘的嵌入与相容操作能够恢复流形的哪些整体和光滑信息？
reports.reading_scope: Publisher HTML initial sections and license; arXiv v1 full main sections 1-5 and selected bibliography. Some diagrams have corrupted HTML TeX serialization and were not transcribed. No independent PDF figure inspection.
reports.license: Publisher CC BY 4.0, IMU 2026. arXiv v1 has non-exclusive distribution license; adaptation attributed to the CC publisher text.
normalization_and_corrections: Use the diffeomorphism groupoid in the definition of structure space; arbitrary embeddings between disconnected closed manifolds need not be onto.
The boundary-relative structure space remembers the cylinder module action, not merely the interior presheaf.
T_infinity is the tower limit, not automatically the embedding space; state handle codimension and low-dimensional convergence hypotheses.
The formal immersion comparison in equal dimension uses the no-closed-components hypothesis.
Finite-level homotopy-sphere equivalences do not imply compatible infinite-level equivalence.
Do not copy the survey's unqualified Euler-class polynomial statement; only the precise Pontryagin nonvanishing theorem is imported.
deferred: Tangential 2-type refinements, graphical rational models, smoothing pullback squares, rational decoupling and stable J detection need further atomic prerequisite development.
Multiple-disjunction estimates, Weiss fibre sequence construction, structure-space infinite delooping and finite-generation research proofs remain cited.
No claim to solve realizability of arbitrary Disc presheaves or the infinite-level bP detection question.

reports.speaker: Maggie Miller
reports.title: Fibered Links in S^4
reports.question: 如何沿带手术延伸圆周纤维化，并通过增补曲面分支控制四维临界点？
reports.reading_scope: Publisher HTML main sections 1-6, figure captions and reference entries; PDF text header checked. PDF screenshot attempts yielded no inspectable image and PDF download returned 403. No claim of independent band-diagram or original 2021 movie verification.
reports.license: Publisher CC BY 4.0, IMU 2026, verified in PDF header
normalization_and_corrections: Correct Proposition 5.1's L/L-prime slip: the enlarged link is fibered, not the arbitrary input link.
Use b=m+M-chi(Sigma), correcting the printed sign in section 5; each half has m-chi/2 bands.
Differentiate slice Morse index, fibre handle type, and four-dimensional interior index.
The surface-link theorem leaves index-2 critical points; the unrestricted fibered superlink statement is an open question.
Use B^4 for ribbon disk exteriors and four-dimensional total domain for the family map.
Keep source figure/movie constructions as explicit external inputs rather than claim verbal outlines replace embedded band moves.
deferred: Independent reconstruction and visual verification of Movies 1, 11, 15, 19, the surface-braiding theorem, and every Yoshikawa table example remain undone.
The Casson-Gordon handlebody-extension proof and general four-dimensional sublink fibering question are not resolved locally.
